_comment: Station on a Spacecraft (721.2b) -- a 4/6 with its P/T box at 5+, a 3+ trigger, a 3+ player static, a 5+ keyword line and an 8+ self-buff, standing in for U.S.S. Prometheus, Uthros Research Craft and Exploration Broodship. Test-only.
